questions.question: Who played the Joker in The Dark Knight?
questions.note: He won a posthumous Best Supporting Actor Oscar. Phoenix is the 2019 Joker; Nicholson is the 1989 film.

questions.question: Who played Loki in the Marvel films?
questions.note: Hemsworth is Thor; Holland is Spider-Man; Cumberbatch is Doctor Strange.

questions.question: Who played Lord Voldemort in the Harry Potter films?
questions.note: Rickman is Snape; Isaacs is Lucius Malfoy; Oldman is Sirius Black.

questions.question: Who played Thanos in the Marvel films?
questions.note: Motion-capture in Infinity War and Endgame. Goldblum is the Grandmaster; Elba is Heimdall.

questions.question: Who played Kylo Ren in the Star Wars sequel trilogy?
questions.note: Isaac is Poe; Boyega is Finn; Gleeson is General Hux.

questions.question: Who played the Green Goblin in Sam Raimi’s Spider-Man (2002)?
questions.note: Norman Osborn. Molina is Doctor Octopus; Franco is Harry Osborn; Simmons is J. Jonah Jameson.

questions.question: Who played Magneto in Bryan Singer’s original X-Men films?
questions.note: Stewart is Professor X. Fassbender plays a younger Magneto in First Class.

questions.question: Who played Erik Killmonger in Black Panther?
questions.note: Boseman is T’Challa. Duke is M’Baku; Kaluuya is W’Kabi.

questions.question: Who played the SS colonel Hans Landa in Inglourious Basterds?
questions.note: He won Best Supporting Actor. Tarantino’s 2009 film; Brad Pitt leads the Basterds.

questions.question: Who played the cyber-terrorist Raoul Silva in Skyfall?
questions.note: 2012, directed by Sam Mendes. Mikkelsen is Le Chiffre in Casino Royale; Fiennes is M.
